task: Predict coronary artery disease (Cath Normal vs CAD) from 55 clinical predictors.
intended_use: Research decision-support prototype: rank and explain stenosis risk for Track A demonstration. Not for diagnosis, triage, or treatment.

training.leakage: LAD/LCX/RCA/Cath columns excluded per-target by the firewall; scaler fit on train only.

limitations: Held-out test n=60. Single-center n=303 (Z-Alizadeh Sani Extension), no external validation; research prototype, not a medical device.
